column2: Identify which phase(s) of the inquiry cycle the lesson focuses on (e.g., tuning in, finding out, sorting out, going further, making conclusions, taking action). This helps frame where students are in the learning journey and how the lesson supports their development of inquiry skills and understanding.

Describe the key activities, tasks, and interactions that will engage students in the learning process. These experiences should be purposeful, connected to the learning goals, and designed to promote inquiry, exploration, and deeper thinking.

List the materials, tools, texts, media, or digital platforms required to support teaching and student learning during the lesson. Include both instructional resources and those needed for student inquiry or hands-on activities.
